text:
Sam: Heads-up 1 we received an RFP from Spectra Systems. They want a written capability matrix, POC plan (4-6 weeks), pricing for hosted vs dedicated, and answers to a security questionnaire. Deadline next Tue EOD.
Lena: noted. any residency restrictions?
Sam: They require EU prod residency; POC can run in eu-west or us-west, they prefer eu-west. Also want KMS with customer-supplied keys + audit logs retained for 3 years.
Diego: I'll own the capability matrix. Plan to show feature columns: model types, streaming, function calls, quantized support, routing/fallbacks, observability hooks. I'll include example perf targets (p95 latency) per model size.
Sam: good. add a section that explains Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs for predictable latency and controlled ingress. Spectra asked specifically about cold-starts and cache priming.
Lena: on pricing: I'll prepare two line-items: (A) Hosted POC - estimated tokens & streaming uplift, (B) Dedicated - 6-week commit of 1x p4d-equivalent (or 2x smaller GPUs) with setup fee. Need ballpark numbers by Fri.
Diego: ops/terraform ask: they want sample IaC modules and an example to provision VPC endpoints + TLS cert path. Minimal snippet for their engineers:
```hcl
module "redwood_private" {
  source  = "git::https://git.redwood.ai/terraform/ri-private.git?ref=v1.3"
  region  = "eu-west-1"
  vpc_id  = "vpc-0abcd1234"
  kms_key_arn = "arn:aws:kms:eu:111111:key/aaaa-bbbb"
}
```
Sam: add a short runbook: failover to smaller model if latency breaches SLO, and steps for rolling back to previous model version. Keep it 1 page.
infra-bot: Reminder: attach SOC2 summary, pen-test exec summary, and recent audit report.
Lena: Spectra's security questionnaire includes questions about HSM support, key-rotation frequency, and SLA for key-usage. Contracts - do we have standard HSM language?
contracts: We have a standard addendum for customer-managed keys and HSM integration. Main concerns: liability for on-prem hardware, export control restrictions, and proof-of-compliance flow. We'll provide redline within 48h. Send drafts to contracts@redwood.com.
Diego: security will also ask about network topology - I'll include a diagram link: https://drive.redwood/diagrams/spectra-vpc-arch.png
QA: For the POC acceptance criteria include throughput target, 99th percentile latency, model quality checks (BLEU/ROUGE/embedding similarity thresholds), and regression tests. We'll provide a small eval suite.
Sam: Spectra asked for a capability matrix CSV and an RFP PDF pack. Who can assemble?
Diego: I'll generate capability_matrix_spectra.csv and attach. It will compare features across hosted/dedicated/private columns.
Lena: I'll populate the pricing spreadsheet and include token estimate assumptions (prompt lengths, responses, concurrency). Will include an option with caching/prefix-priming savings.
Sam: timeline: prep draft by Thu EOD, internal review Fri 10am PT, send to Spectra Tue EOD.
contracts: Also flag that if they insist on on-prem HSM we need an SOW for hardware integration and an ops support rate.
Lena: under that scenario, add line item: on-prem HSM integration (engineering hours + travel if on-site).
Diego: I'll add a short sample routing policy for canary and fallback so they can see how we avoid noisy neighbor effects.
Sam: Great. @QA, @contracts, @infra-bot please post your artifacts (SOC2/pen-test, redlines, diagram) by Wed EOD so we can finalize. :thumbsup:
QA: will upload eval suite and test plan Wed morning.
infra-bot: Uploaded exec summaries to drive: https://drive.redwood/reports/spectra-pack
contracts: redlines will be in inbox by Wed 4pm.
Sam: Thanks team. We'll do a dry-run of the RFP package review Friday 10am PT. Spectra contact will be looped after internal signoff.
Lena: I'll share the pricing spreadsheet link in the thread once done.
Diego: adding small note: for Dedicated POC, recommend enabling prefix caching and token batching to reduce cost ~20-40% depending on workload.
Sam: noted. wrapping up 1  - everyone please keep changes small after Fri review. We'll attach capability_matrix_spectra.csv and spectra_poc_runbook.pdf to the outbound package.
